SELECT DISTINCT TEMP.*,( select fc.currency_name from fnd_currency fc where fc.currency_code = TEMP.PLANNED_CURRENCY_CODE ) as planned_currency_code_n FROM () TEMP WHERE 1=1 AND TEMP.COMPANY_ID = #{request.companyId} AND ( nvl(TEMP.SURPLUS_AMOUNT ,0)- nvl( ( SELECT SUM(TL.APPLY_PAY_AMOUNT) FROM EFT_FUND_TRANSFER_LIST TL, EFT_FUND_TRANSFER T WHERE TL.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY=TEMP.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY AND TL.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID=TEMP.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID AND TL.TRANSFER_ID=T.TRANSFER_ID AND TL.TRANSFER_TYPE='PAY' AND T.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND TL.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND T.BUSINESS_TYPE='FUND' AND TL.TRANSFER_STATUS='NEW'),0))>0
AND TEMP.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{organizationName}),'%')
AND TEMP.MAJOR_CONTRACT_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{majorContractNumber}),'%')
AND TEMP.SOURCE_DOC_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{sourceDocNumber}),'%')
AND (TEMP.SOURCE_DOC_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{sourceDocName}),'%') OR TEMP.MAJOR_CONTRACT_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{sourceDocName}),'%') OR TEMP.SOURCE_DOC_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{sourceDocName}),'%') )
AND TEMP.PLANNED_DUE_DATE >= #{dueDateStart}
AND TEMP.PLANNED_DUE_DATE <= #{dueDateEnd}
ORDER BY TEMP.PLANNED_DUE_DATE

SELECT DISTINCT temp.source_doc_line_id,temp.source_doc_number,temp.source_doc_category,temp.source_doc_id,temp.apply_currency_code, temp.out_bank_account_id,temp.out_bank_branch_name,temp.out_bank_account_num,temp.out_bank_account_name,temp.in_bank_account_id, temp.in_bank_branch_name,temp.in_bank_account_name,temp.in_bank_account_num,temp.source_doc_name,temp.apply_purpose,temp.bp_id, temp.organization_name,temp.times,temp.cf_type,temp.cf_item,temp.planned_due_date,temp.planned_currency_code,temp.exchange_rate, temp.lock_rate_flag,temp.planned_due_amount,temp.major_contract_number,temp.cf_item_desc,temp.cny_planned_due_amount FROM () TEMP WHERE 1=1 AND TEMP.COMPANY_ID = #{request.companyId} AND ( nvl(TEMP.SURPLUS_AMOUNT ,0)- nvl( ( SELECT SUM(TL.APPLY_PAY_AMOUNT) FROM EFT_FUND_TRANSFER_LIST TL, EFT_FUND_TRANSFER T WHERE TL.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY=TEMP.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY AND TL.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID=TEMP.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID AND TL.TRANSFER_ID=T.TRANSFER_ID AND TL.TRANSFER_TYPE='PAY' AND T.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND TL.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND T.BUSINESS_TYPE='FUND' AND TL.TRANSFER_STATUS='NEW'),0))>0 ORDER BY TEMP.PLANNED_DUE_DATE
SELECT '-'|| nvl(REPLACE(LPAD(MAX(SUBSTR(EFTL.TRANSFER_NUMBER, -2, 2)) + 1, 2), ' ', '0'), '01') FROM EFT_FUND_TRANSFER_LIST EFTL WHERE EFTL.TRANSFER_ID=#{transferId}

SELECT BALANCE.* , fc.currency_name apply_currency_code_n FROM ( SELECT ACCOUNT.APPLY_PAY_AMOUNT, to_date(ACCOUNT.APPLY_PAY_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') APPLY_PAY_DATE, nvl(CBAB.ACCOUNT_BALANCE,0)+(SUM(nvl(ACCOUNT.APPLY_PAY_AMOUNT,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY ACCOUNT.IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID ORDER BY ACCOUNT.APPLY_PAY_DATE ) ) ACCOUNT_BALANCE, ACCOUNT.IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, CBA.CURRENCY APPLY_CURRENCY_CODE, CBA.BANK_BRANCH_NAME IN_BANK_BRANCH_NAME, CBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, CBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM, CB.BANK_NAME IN_BANK_NAME FROM ( SELECT AC.IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, AC.APPLY_PAY_DATE APPLY_PAY_DATE, SUM(AC.APPLY_PAY_AMOUNT) APPLY_PAY_AMOUNT FROM ( SELECT CPRL.SELF_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, CPRH.PAYMENT_REQ_DATE APPLY_PAY_DATE, -(CPRL.AMOUNT-nvl(CPRL.AMOUNT_PAID,0)) APPLY_PAY_AMOUNT FROM CSH_PAYMENT_REQ_LN CPRL JOIN CSH_PAYMENT_REQ_HD CPRH ON CPRH.PAYMENT_REQ_ID = CPRL.PAYMENT_REQ_ID JOIN CON_CONTRACT CC ON CPRH.SOURCE_DOC_ID = CC.CONTRACT_ID AND CPRH.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE='CON_CONTRACT' WHERE CPRL.PAYMENT_FLAG IN ('NOT', 'PARTIAL') AND CC.CONTRACT_STATUS IN ('SIGN', 'LOAN') AND CPRH.PAYMENT_REQ_STATUS='APPROVED' AND CC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND CPRL.SELF_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CPRL.SELF_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID , CPRH.PAYMENT_REQ_DATE, -(CPRL.AMOUNT-nvl(CPRL.AMOUNT_PAID,0)) AMOUNT FROM CSH_PAYMENT_REQ_LN CPRL JOIN CSH_PAYMENT_REQ_HD CPRH ON CPRH.PAYMENT_REQ_ID = CPRL.PAYMENT_REQ_ID JOIN FCT_CONTRACT FC ON CPRH.SOURCE_DOC_ID = FC.CONTRACT_ID AND CPRH.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE='FCT_CONTRACT' WHERE FC.CONTRACT_STATUS IN ('SIGN', 'LOAN') AND CPRH.DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'PAYMENT_REQ' AND CPRL.PAYMENT_FLAG IN ('NOT', 'PARTIAL') AND CPRH.PAYMENT_REQ_STATUS='APPROVED' AND CPRL.SELF_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CC.RETURN_ACCOUNT, CCC.DUE_DATE, (CCC.DUE_AMOUNT-nvl(CCC.RECEIVED_AMOUNT,0)) AMOUNT FROM CON_CONTRACT CC JOIN CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC ON CC.CONTRACT_ID=CCC.CONTRACT_ID WHERE CCC.CF_DIRECTION='INFLOW' AND nvl(CCC.WRITE_OFF_FLAG,'NOT') !='FULL' AND CC.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' AND CCC.CF_STATUS = 'RELEASE' AND CC.RETURN_ACCOUNT IS NOT NULL AND (( CC.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT') OR ( CCC.TIMES=0 AND CC.CONTRACT_STATUS IN('SIGN', 'LOAN')) OR ( CC.CONTRACT_STATUS='PENDING' AND ( ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CON_CONTRACT FT WHERE FT.DATA_CLASS='CHANGE_REQ' AND FT.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' AND FT.REF_CONTRACT_ID=CC.CONTRACT_ID ) >0))) UNION ALL SELECT FC.FCT_PAYMENT_ACCOUNT_ID, FQC.DUE_DATE, (FQC.DUE_AMOUNT-nvl(FQC.RECEIVED_AMOUNT,0)) AMOUNT FROM FCT_CONTRACT FC JOIN FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC ON FC.CONTRACT_ID=FQC.CONTRACT_ID WHERE FQC.CF_DIRECTION='INFLOW' AND nvl(FQC.WRITE_OFF_FLAG,'NOT') !='FULL' AND FC.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' AND FQC.CF_STATUS = 'RELEASE' AND FC.FCT_PAYMENT_ACCOUNT_ID IS NOT NULL AND (( FC.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT') OR ( FQC.TIMES=0 AND FC.CONTRACT_STATUS IN('SIGN', 'LOAN')) OR ( FC.CONTRACT_STATUS='PENDING' AND ( ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM FCT_CONTRACT FT WHERE FT.DATA_CLASS='CHANGE_REQ' AND FT.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' AND FT.REF_CONTRACT_ID=FC.CONTRACT_ID ) >0))) UNION ALL SELECT TEMP.* FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN LCR.CF_ITEM=301 THEN BAPRI.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID WHEN LCR.CF_ITEM=302 THEN BAINT.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID WHEN LCR.CF_ITEM=310 THEN BAFEE.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID END BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, LCR.PLANNED_DUE_DATE, -ROUND(LCR.PLANNED_DUE_AMOUNT*nvl(LCR.EXCHANGE_RATE,1),2)-ifnull (LCR.CNY_DUE_AMOUNT,0) AMOUNT FROM LON_CONTRACT_REPAYMENT LCR JOIN LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW LCW ON LCW.WITHDRAW_ID=LCR.WITHDRAW_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CLCBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, CLCBA.CONTRACT_ID FROM CT_LON_CONTRACT_BANK_ACCOUNT CLCBA WHERE CLCBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE='FINANCING_ACCOUNT' AND CLCBA.ACCOUNT_SOURCE='OUR_ACCOUNT' ) BAPRI ON BAPRI.CONTRACT_ID=LCW.CONTRACT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CLCBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, CLCBA.CONTRACT_ID FROM CT_LON_CONTRACT_BANK_ACCOUNT CLCBA WHERE CLCBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE='FINANCING_INTEREST_ACCOUNT' AND CLCBA.ACCOUNT_SOURCE='OUR_ACCOUNT') BAINT ON BAINT.CONTRACT_ID=LCW.CONTRACT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CLCBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, CLCBA.CONTRACT_ID FROM CT_LON_CONTRACT_BANK_ACCOUNT CLCBA WHERE CLCBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE='FINANCING_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT' AND CLCBA.ACCOUNT_SOURCE='OUR_ACCOUNT' ) BAFEE ON BAFEE.CONTRACT_ID=LCW.CONTRACT_ID WHERE LCW.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND LCW.WITHDRAW_STATUS IN('APPROVED', 'PENDING') AND nvl(LCR.WRITE_OFF_FLAG,'NOT')!='FULL') TEMP WHERE TEMP.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT TEMP.* FROM ( SELECT CASE CAPR.CF_ITEM WHEN 301 THEN BAPRI.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID WHEN 302 THEN BAINT.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID WHEN 201 THEN REGA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID WHEN 202 THEN REGA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID END BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, CAPR.PLANNED_DUE_DATE, CAPR.AMOUNT FROM ( SELECT LAPR.PRODUCT_ID, LAPR.CF_ITEM, LAPR.PLANNED_DUE_DATE, -ROUND(LAPR.PLANNED_DUE_AMOUNT*nvl(LAPR.EXCHANGE_RATE,1),2)-ifnull (LAPR.CNY_DUE_AMOUNT,0) AMOUNT FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_REPAYMENT LAPR WHERE nvl(LAPR.WRITE_OFF_FLAG,'NOT')!='FULL' UNION ALL SELECT CAPC.PRODUCT_ID, CAPC.COLLECTION_CF_ITEM CF_ITEM, CAPC.COLLECTION_DATE, CAPC.COLLECTION_AMOUNT-nvl(CAPC.COLLECTION_RECEIVER_AMOUNT,0) AMOUNT FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION CAPC WHERE CAPC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND CAPC.COLLECTION_AMOUNT-nvl(CAPC.COLLECTION_RECEIVER_AMOUNT,0)>0 UNION ALL SELECT CAPC.PRODUCT_ID, CAPC.REMITTANCE_CF_ITEM CF_ITEM, CAPC.REMITTANCE_DATE, -(CAPC.REMITTANCE_AMOUNT-nvl(CAPC.REMITTANCE_RECEIVER_AMOUNT,0) ) AMOUNT FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION CAPC WHERE CAPC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND CAPC.REMITTANCE_AMOUNT-nvl(CAPC.REMITTANCE_RECEIVER_AMOUNT,0)>0 ) CAPR JOIN CT_ABS_PRODUCT CAP ON CAP.PRODUCT_ID=CAPR.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CABA.ABS_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, CABA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, CABA.SOURCE_KEY FROM CT_ABS_BANK_ACCOUNT CABA WHERE CABA.SOURCE_TYPE='ABS_PRODUCT' AND CABA.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE='PRINCIPAL_ACCOUNT' AND CABA.ACCOUNT_SOURCE_TYPE='OUR_ACCOUNT') BAPRI ON BAPRI.SOURCE_KEY=CAP.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CABA.ABS_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, CABA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, CABA.SOURCE_KEY FROM CT_ABS_BANK_ACCOUNT CABA WHERE CABA.SOURCE_TYPE='ABS_PRODUCT' AND CABA.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE='INTEREST_ACCOUNT' AND CABA.ACCOUNT_SOURCE_TYPE='OUR_ACCOUNT') BAINT ON BAINT.SOURCE_KEY=CAP.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CABA.ABS_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, CABA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, CABA.SOURCE_KEY FROM CT_ABS_BANK_ACCOUNT CABA WHERE CABA.SOURCE_TYPE='ABS_PRODUCT' AND CABA.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE='REGULATORY_ACCOUNT' AND CABA.ACCOUNT_SOURCE_TYPE='OUR_ACCOUNT') REGA ON REGA.SOURCE_KEY=CAP.PRODUCT_ID WHERE CAP.PRODUCT_STATUS IN ('APPROVED' , 'PENDING') AND CAP.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL') TEMP WHERE TEMP.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT EFTL.OUT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, EFTL.APPLY_PAY_DATE, - EFTL.APPLY_PAY_AMOUNT FROM EFT_FUND_TRANSFER_LIST EFTL WHERE EFTL.TRANSFER_STATUS='NEW' AND EFTL.TRANSFER_TYPE='TRANSFER' AND nvl(EFTL.APPLY_PAY_AMOUNT,0)!=0 AND EFTL.OUT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT EFTL.IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, EFTL.APPLY_PAY_DATE, EFTL.APPLY_PAY_AMOUNT FROM EFT_FUND_TRANSFER_LIST EFTL WHERE EFTL.TRANSFER_STATUS='NEW' AND EFTL.TRANSFER_TYPE='TRANSFER' AND nvl(EFTL.APPLY_PAY_AMOUNT,0)!=0 AND EFTL.IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID IS NOT NULL) AC WHERE 1=1 AND AC.APPLY_PAY_DATE >= sysdate AND AC.APPLY_PAY_DATE< sysdate+30 AND AC.IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY AC.IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, AC.APPLY_PAY_DATE ORDER BY AC.APPLY_PAY_DATE) ACCOUNT JOIN CSH_BANK_ACCOUNT CBA ON CBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID=ACCOUNT.IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID JOIN CSH_BANK CB ON CB.BANK_ID=CBA.BANK_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, BALANCE_DATE, ACCOUNT_BALANCE FROM ( SELECT -- ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY AB.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID ORDER BY AB.BALANCE_DATE -- DESC) RN, IF ( @p = AB.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, @rank := @rank + 1 ,@rank := 1 ) AS RN, @p := AB.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID as rank1, AB.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, AB.BALANCE_DATE, AB.ACCOUNT_BALANCE FROM CAP_ACCOUNT_MONTHLY_BALANCE AB,(SELECT @p := NULL ,@rank := 0) r) WHERE RN = 1) CBAB ON CBAB.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID=ACCOUNT.IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID ) BALANCE left join fnd_currency fc on fc.currency_code = balance.APPLY_CURRENCY_CODE WHERE BALANCE.ACCOUNT_BALANCE <0
AND (BALANCE.IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{inBankAccountName}),'%') OR BALANCE.IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{inBankAccountName}),'%') OR BALANCE.IN_BANK_BRANCH_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{inBankAccountName}),'%') OR BALANCE.IN_BANK_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{inBankAccountName}),'%') )
AND BALANCE.APPLY_PAY_DATE >= #{dueDateStart}
AND BALANCE.APPLY_PAY_DATE <= #{dueDateEnd}
ORDER BY BALANCE.APPLY_PAY_DATE

SELECT CBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, CBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, CBA.BANK_BRANCH_NAME IN_BANK_BRANCH_NAME, CBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM IN_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM, CB.BANK_NAME IN_BANK_NAME, nvl(CBAB.ACCOUNT_BALANCE,0) ACCOUNT_BALANCE FROM CSH_BANK_ACCOUNT CBA JOIN CSH_BANK CB ON CB.BANK_ID=CBA.BANK_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, BALANCE_DATE, ACCOUNT_BALANCE FROM ( SELECT -- ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY AB.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID ORDER BY AB.BALANCE_DATE -- DESC) RN, IF ( @p = AB.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, @rank := @rank + 1 ,@rank := 1 ) AS RN, @p := AB.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID as rank1, AB.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, AB.BALANCE_DATE, AB.ACCOUNT_BALANCE FROM CAP_ACCOUNT_MONTHLY_BALANCE AB,(SELECT @p := NULL ,@rank := 0) r) WHERE RN = 1) CBAB ON CBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID=CBAB.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID WHERE 1=1
AND CBA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = #{bankAccountId}

SELECT nvl(SOD.SURPLUS_AMOUNT,0)-nvl(EFTL.ACTUAL_PAY_AMOUNT,0) FROM ( SELECT L.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY, L.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID, SUM(nvl(L.ACTUAL_PAY_AMOUNT,0)) ACTUAL_PAY_AMOUNT FROM EFT_FUND_TRANSFER_LIST L WHERE L.TRANSFER_STATUS='NEW' AND L.TRANSFER_TYPE='PAY' GROUP BY L.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY, L.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID) EFTL JOIN ( SELECT LCW.COMPANY_ID, LCR.REPAYMENT_ID SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID, LCR.WITHDRAW_ID SOURCE_DOC_ID, 'LON_CONTRACT_REPAYMENT' SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY, LCR.PLANNED_DUE_AMOUNT-nvl(LCR.DUE_AMOUNT,0) SURPLUS_AMOUNT FROM LON_CONTRACT_REPAYMENT LCR JOIN LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW LCW ON LCW.WITHDRAW_ID=LCR.WITHDRAW_ID WHERE LCW.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' UNION ALL SELECT CAP.COMPANY_ID, PFI.FEE_INFO_ID SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID, CAP.PROJECT_ID SOURCE_DOC_ID, 'CT_ABS_PROJECT_FEE' SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY, PFI.FEE_AMOUNT-nvl(PFI.WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT,0) SURPLUS_AMOUNT FROM CT_ABS_PRO_FEE_INFO PFI JOIN CT_ABS_PROJECT CAP ON PFI.SOURCE_KEY=CAP.PROJECT_ID WHERE PFI.SOURCE_TYPE='ABS_PROJECT' UNION ALL SELECT CAP.COMPANY_ID, CAPR.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID, CAPR.SOURCE_DOC_ID, CAPR.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY, CAPR.SURPLUS_AMOUNT FROM ( SELECT PR.REPAYMENT_ID SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID, PR.PRODUCT_ID SOURCE_DOC_ID, 'CT_ABS_PRODUCT_REPAYMENT' SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY, PR.PLANNED_DUE_AMOUNT, PR.PLANNED_DUE_AMOUNT-nvl(PR.DUE_AMOUNT,0) SURPLUS_AMOUNT FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_REPAYMENT PR UNION ALL SELECT PFI.FEE_INFO_ID, PFI.SOURCE_KEY, 'CT_ABS_PRODUCT_FEE' SOURCE_TYPE, PFI.FEE_AMOUNT, PFI.FEE_AMOUNT-nvl(PFI.WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT,0) SURPLUS_AMOUNT FROM CT_ABS_PRO_FEE_INFO PFI, CT_ABS_PRODUCT_ORGANIZATION CAPO WHERE PFI.SOURCE_TYPE='ABS_PRODUCT' AND CAPO.ORGANIZATION_ID=PFI.ORGANIZATION_ID UNION ALL SELECT CAPC.COLLECTION_ID, CAPC.PRODUCT_ID, 'CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION' SOURCE_TYPE, CAPC.COLLECTION_AMOUNT, nvl(CAPC.COLLECTION_AMOUNT,0)-nvl(CAPC.COLLECTION_RECEIVER_AMOUNT,0) SURPLUS_AMOUNT FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION CAPC WHERE CAPC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' UNION ALL SELECT CAPC.COLLECTION_ID, CAPC.PRODUCT_ID, 'CT_ABS_PRODUCT_REMITTANCE' SOURCE_TYPE, CAPC.REMITTANCE_AMOUNT, nvl(CAPC.REMITTANCE_AMOUNT,0)-nvl(CAPC.REMITTANCE_RECEIVER_AMOUNT,0) SURPLUS_AMOUNT FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION CAPC WHERE CAPC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' UNION ALL SELECT CAPB.BUYBACK_ID, CAPB.PRODUCT_ID, 'CT_ABS_PRODUCT_BUYBACK' SOURCE_TYPE, CAPB.BUYBACK_AMOUNT, nvl(CAPB.BUYBACK_AMOUNT,0)-nvl(CAPB.RECEIVER_AMOUNT,0) SURPLUS_AMOUNT FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_BUYBACK CAPB ) CAPR JOIN CT_ABS_PRODUCT CAP ON CAP.PRODUCT_ID=CAPR.SOURCE_DOC_ID WHERE CAP.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' ) SOD ON SOD.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY=EFTL.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY AND SOD.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID=EFTL.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID WHERE EFTL.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY=#{sourceDocCategory} AND EFTL.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID=#{sourceDocLineId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM EFT_FUND_TRANSFER_LIST EFTL WHERE nvl(EFTL.ACTUAL_PAY_AMOUNT,0)!=nvl(EFTL.PLANNED_DUE_AMOUNT,0) AND EFTL.TRANSFER_TYPE='PAY' AND EFTL.FIN_TRANSFER_ID = #{finTransferId}
